speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Coronary Syndrome (likely Unstable Angina or NSTEMI). Given the classic presentation of exertional chest pain radiating to the jaw and left arm with diaphoresis, this is highly suggestive of cardiac ischemia.
